scope: Packet04 source-only implementation design and runtime entry pin delta. No implementation, author allocation, operational, ledger, Preview, or sprint acceptance.

reviewer.identityLimit: Canonical serving model identity and effective reasoning setting are not independently exposed or verified.

timing.limit: Native wall-clock allowance; no cgroup enforcement. Queue time and parent-observed fresh start are recorded separately.

verification.entryMapping: Independent recursive enumeration of package main/module/exports JavaScript paths plus package-owned WASM exactly matched manifest present and absent sets. Every admitted entry/backing file and package.json is pinned.
verification.absentDisposition: All 23 advertised absent entries are actually absent and excluded from admission: compact-js 11 CJS and platform-js 12 CJS entries. Present ESM entries remain available.
verification.pinChecks: All 201 file hashes verified twice; original 61 hashes unchanged.
verification.toolchain: Pinned custody bindings are authoritative; recorded Node 24.18.1, Compact wrapper 0.5.2, compiler 0.31.1, language 0.23.0 and runtime 0.16.0 agree with packet.

findings.detail: Parent-supplied manifest now binds present runtime entry and package-owned WASM bytes before author work. Loader must verify package.json, selected admitted entry and associated WASM before import. Absent or unlisted direct entries fail closed and require parent inspection; no downloads are admitted.

carryForward: Prior packet03 signature/reservation-before-finalize, retained pending-state failure handling, source-derived financial inputs, metadata layout/identity-only use, provenance separation, rational remainder and typed BlockHashConfig corrections remain intact. This delta did not repeat their complete source review.
limits: Coverage is explicit entry/backing integrity, not complete transitive dependency closure or evidence that every advertised module path can execute.
Retained r3-native dependency cache must remain protected throughout the stated campaign.
Legacy comparator remains networkAcceptance:false; fixture/projection success cannot establish actual receipt or network acceptance.
Author stage remains unallocated. Later build, real local and Preview actions need separate admission.
historicalInventoryError: runtime-pin-correction.json preserves the parent initial missing-export assertion failure before writes; revised inventory explicitly excludes absent exports.
actions: Read-only file/hash/package metadata inspection; no SDK imports, builds, installs, key/environment access, endpoint calls, chain submissions or source changes.
